market_strategy: CEO Bill McDermott: ServiceNow AI ACV surpassed a billion and is on track to beat the $1.5B 2026 target (2026-07-22, eneralabs.com); AI revenue will blow past a billion and a half (2026-04-23, fortune.com); AI to reach 30% of revenue by 2030 (Deutsche Bank conference transcript, about 2026-08-30, stockanalysis.com).
bull: Q2 2026 (2026-07-22): subscription revenue $3,877M +24.5% YoY, revenue/EPS beat, FY guide raised to $15.76-15.78B; AI ACV crossed $1B toward $1.5B; six dated raises 90d (Needham 115->155, Cantor 141->174).
bear: Gross margin eased to 74.77% TTM from 77.53% FY2025; seat-based licensing erosion from AI agents (2026-09-24 zacks.com); five CVEs disclosed 2026-09-24; stock -47% drawdown; mean target $144.99 is perverse per §17.
falsifier: Q3 2026 report (~2026-10-28): FY2026 subscription guidance cut below $15.76B, or subscription growth under ~22% YoY, or AI ACV not tracking toward $1.5B.

web_bottleneck: ServiceNow relieves AI value stuck in silos across workflows and data (2025-12-30, @ServiceNow pinned post). Its own bottleneck is monetising AI and defending seat-based licensing as the AI-agent economy unbundles user seats (2026-09-24, zacks.com).
web_who_benefits_next: Partners and integrators: NVIDIA, Microsoft, Accenture, Infosys (2026-09-22, fool.com) and implementers such as INRY, which deployed EmployeeWorks (2026-09-23, finance.yahoo.com). Second order: cloud infrastructure and AI-governance and security tooling that host agentic enterprise workloads.
web_who_loses: Salesforce, whose CRM turf ServiceNow is attacking with its AI platform (2026-09-22, fool.com Salesforce-vs-ServiceNow), plus seat-priced workflow and ITSM peers such as Atlassian, Monday.com and BMC competing for the same enterprise software budget (2026-09-23, 247wallst.com).
web_margin_collapse_risk: Seat-based pricing erosion as AI agents shrink licensed-user counts (2026-09-24, zacks.com); AI compute and inference cost inside consumption pricing; gross margin already eased to 74.77% TTM from 77.53% in FY2025 (stockanalysis.com). web_low_cost_substitute: not found. I read no dated primary or wire evidence of a Chinese or other low-cost substitute approaching parity; the only related context is general AI-agent pricing pressure on seat-based software (2026-09-24, zacks.com).
web_ceo_promised: CEO Bill McDermott: ServiceNow AI ACV surpassed a billion and is on track to beat the $1.5B 2026 target (2026-07-22, eneralabs.com); AI revenue will blow past a billion and a half (2026-04-23, fortune.com); AI to reach 30% of revenue by 2030 (Deutsche Bank conference transcript, about 2026-08-30, stockanalysis.com).
web_did_they_deliver: Mostly yes: AI ACV rose from $750M in Q1 2026 (2026-05-13, fastcompany.com) past $1B in Q2 2026 (2026-07-22, eneralabs.com), and the earlier $1B 2026 AI sales goal was raised. Q2 2026 revenue $3.99B beat $3.93B and EPS $0.90 beat $0.86 (2026-07-22, marketbeat.com).
web_what_would_falsify: The Q3 2026 report, estimated 2026-10-28 (marketbeat.com): FY2026 subscription revenue guided below $15.76-15.78B, or AI ACV failing to track toward $1.5B by year-end, or subscription growth below about 22% YoY, or any guidance cut.
